about: Hand labels for the curation probes (Task 3 of the Curation plan), written and committed before any model call. World: a copy of the owner's acceptance snapshot (head rev 25, present year 1000). Fact ids are the first 8 hex characters. Worlds: 'head' is the snapshot; 'undo N' is the snapshot with every revision from N on undone (World.undo); 'w5' is the head with the White Talon put back to a fact-less stub (its 12 facts removed, a stub marker set) so the Tsardom is a nation sphere and the regiment has never been expanded. Generated text can't be labelled in advance: probes 1 and 4 are labelled as rubrics (what is on topic, which homes are acceptable for which topic, what counts as a belief), and each generated fact is judged against its rubric after the run, by hand, not blind (as in the fact placement probe's b_judged). Probes 2, 3 and the same-thing verdict are labelled fact by fact.

conventions.bar: A probe passes when at least 80% of its labelled cases are right and at most 5% are false moves or false flags (spec, 'Pass bars and fallbacks').
conventions.probe1_right: an own fact (create: facts; core: summary, timeline and items; Fill: new_items) is on topic when its rubric says so; an elsewhere item is right when its target is an acceptable home for its topic (an existing entry, or a new name when the rubric allows a new entry for that topic).
conventions.probe1_false_move: an elsewhere item whose text is mainly about the entry being written (it belonged here).
conventions.probe2_right: share of 'move' labels the reply's move_in holds; 'either' labels aren't scored.
conventions.probe2_false: share of 'stay' labels the reply's move_in holds.
conventions.probe3_right: share of labelled contradictions found (any listed alternative pair counts).
conventions.probe3_false: a fact that appears in a flagged pair that is no labelled contradiction (nor a 'bonus' one), over the facts in no labelled contradiction.
conventions.probe4_right: share of 'belief' facts (bare belief claims, rubric below) marked held_by the right holder.
conventions.probe4_false: share of plain world facts marked held_by anything. 'attributed' facts (the text itself says 'the Church teaches/holds/interprets') are right either way and not scored.
conventions.probe5_right: a positive run proposes the chain: the regiment's part_of names a new body that the reply lists in names as a sphere (template order) whose part_of is the Tsardom of Moscavia under Governance & Military (or a new Military drawer of it), with a sensible name (an army or host of the Tsardom).
conventions.probe5_false: a run that invents an outer body (a new sphere in names that the entry or a name is put inside) where none is wanted: every probe 1 create run, plus the negative cases.
conventions.same_right: same-or-not: 'same' for a same pair, anything else for a not-same pair.

probe4.belief: a bare claim about the Light's will, nature or acts, or about divine favour: that the Light chose, blesses or guides the Tsar; that the transformation was the Light's act, grace, revelation or a raising to a higher state; that the Light is the source of creation or truth; that darkness is the absence of divine knowledge; what the faithful will receive. Must be held_by the Church.
probe4.attributed: a claim whose own text says the Church (or the faithful, or the doctrine) teaches, holds, interprets or believes it: held_by the Church or null are both right; not scored.
probe4.plain: everything else: that an event happened, a law, rite or office as practised, where something is, who did what, what a doctrine is used for, how it's taught. Must be null.
